name: memolens
description: Private local photo search for Codex through read-only SQLite, with optional user-trusted MemoLens loopback features.

interface.shortDescription: Search and narrate your private local photos.
interface.longDescription: MemoLens lets Codex search a local photo index through SQLite opened read-only, inspect traversal-checked matches with Codex vision, and create grounded albums or narratives. No third-party model API key is required. The unauthenticated loopback API is disabled by default and requires explicit user opt-in for memories and cleanup reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search my local MemoLens library, inspect the strongest matching photos with Codex vision, and create a grounded album or narrative without changing my originals.
